applicabilityBasis.summary: mTBILL is a NAV-linked investment certificate issued by Midas Software GmbH. The July 17, 2026 final terms identify a Treasury-bill underlying and USDC subscription and settlement. The incorporated product terms provide redemption by reference to NAV per token less fees, subject to gates and holdbacks, rather than a fixed USD 1 redemption obligation. This supports non-payment-token without inferring a U.S. securities-law exclusion from European or Swiss classification.

genius.notes: This assessment follows the documented variable-value investment certificate and does not assert a U.S. federal securities determination. The July 17, 2026 base prospectus names Midas Software GmbH in Berlin, Germany and continues this token series. FMA prospectus approval concerns the prospectus and does not establish GENIUS issuer authorization. Public disclosure and enforcement fields are omitted where this adjudication could not independently substantiate them.
